maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'

The full suite is green. Here's what I implemented.

## Summary

The change rejects creating an owner that is missing or blank in any of `firstName`, `lastName`, `address`, `city`, or `telephone`, responding **400** with a JSON body whose `errors` array lists each offending field name.

Following the OfficeFloor function-injection conventions in `AGENTS.md`, I added a dedicated `Validate` step at the front of the `POST /api/owners` pipeline rather than validating inside the builder.

**Changes:**

1. **`ValidateOwner.java`** — now the first step of the pipeline (it already existed but was unused by the POST). It is the single step binding `@Valid @RequestBody OwnerFieldsDto`, then explicitly checks all five fields for null/blank, collecting missing names in field order and throwing a checked `OwnerFieldsMissingException` when any are present; otherwise it republishes the body as `Out<OwnerFieldsDto>`.

2. **`BuildOwner.java`** — switched from `@Valid @RequestBody` to `@Val OwnerFieldsDto`, so only one step binds the body (the body can be read only once).

3. **`owners.POST.yml`** — inserted the `validate` step (runs before the transactional steps, so an invalid body is a 400 before any write begins).

4. **`OwnerFieldsMissingException` + handler + escalation YAML** — the handler responds 400 with `{"errors": [...field names...]}`.

5. **`ValidationExceptionHandler.java`** — extended so missing fields caught by bean validation's `@NotNull` (e.g. an *absent* `city`) also surface a top-level `errors` array, keeping both validation paths consistent.

Why two paths both emit `errors`: a *missing* field trips the generated DTO's `@NotNull` (handled by `ValidationExceptionHandler`), while a *whitespace-only* `address`/`city` passes bean validation (only `@Size(min=1)`, no pattern) and is caught by the explicit blank check in `ValidateOwner` — so the spec's "missing **or** blank" is fully covered for all five fields, and existing format validation (patterns, sizes) is preserved.

All 3 acceptance tests pass (`BUILD SUCCESS`).
